source: ZXNAME0000XZ CDNA generations likewise evolve matrix formats, compute-unit structure, packaging, and memory systems. CDNA 3, for example, extends Matrix Core datatype support and underlies the MI300 accelerator family.[10]
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ cDNA 世代同样演进了矩阵格式、计算单元结构、封装和存储系统。例如，CDNA 3 扩展了 Matrix Core 数据类型支持，并成为 MI300 加速器系列的基础。 [10]
